title: 2019 in review
summary: 2019 was probably the most eventful year I've had. It was so densely packed with stuff happening around me, that at the end of it it feels that I can't even recall most of them. Luckily, this year I was almost consistent with writing my personal journal, and that helped me extract a lot of these forgotten memories out of my hazy mind.
